mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT a.field_code FROM sys_org_auth a INNER JOIN sys_org_role_auth ra ON a.field_id = ra.field_auth_id WHERE ra.field_role_id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT r.field_id FROM sys_org_role r INNER JOIN sys_org_role_element re ON r.field_id = re.field_role_id WHERE re.field_element_id IN ( -- 用户自身组织元素 SELECT e.field_id FROM sys_org_element e WHERE e.field_id = #{userId} AND e.field_org_type = 3 UNION -- 用户所属岗位 SELECT pu.field_post_id FROM sys_org_post_user pu WHERE pu.field_user_id = #{userId} UNION -- 用户所属虚拟组织 SELECT vu.field_virtual_id FROM sys_org_virtual_user vu WHERE vu.field_user_id = #{userId} UNION -- 用户直属组织链路上的机构/部门 SELECT anc.field_id FROM sys_org_element anc INNER JOIN sys_org_element u ON u.field_id = #{userId} AND u.field_org_type = 3 WHERE anc.field_org_type IN (1, 2) AND u.field_hierarchy IS NOT NULL AND u.field_hierarchy LIKE CONCAT('%/', anc.field_id, '/%') ) ) AND a.field_code IS NOT NULL ORDER BY a.field_code

SELECT
FROM sys_org_auth
AND field_id = #{model.fieldId} AND field_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{model.fieldName}, '%') AND field_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{model.fieldCode}, '%') AND field_model = #{model.fieldModel} AND field_description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{model.fieldDescription}, '%')
ORDER BY field_name

SELECT a.field_id, a.field_name, a.field_code, a.field_model, a.field_description FROM sys_org_auth a INNER JOIN sys_org_role_auth ra ON a.field_id = ra.field_auth_id WHERE ra.field_role_id = #{roleId} ORDER BY a.field_model, a.field_name

SELECT DISTINCT a.field_id, a.field_name, a.field_code, a.field_model, a.field_description FROM sys_org_auth a INNER JOIN sys_org_role_auth ra ON a.field_id = ra.field_auth_id WHERE ra.field_role_id IN #{roleId} ORDER BY a.field_model, a.field_name
